Component specific attribution and rights

Upstream APEX data

Mohamed Hydher, M. H. (2026). APEX Dataset: Testbed Traces and Evaluation
Results (Version 1.0). Graz University of Technology.
Dataset DOI: https://doi.org/10.3217/3dhx0-2k125
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The unchanged original files are:
 p9/licence/apex_dataset/Crystal_results.json
 p9/licence/apex_dataset/RPL_results.json
 p9/licence/apex_dataset/README.md
Their exact sizes and SHA256 values are in MANIFEST.json and
HISTORICAL_BYTE_PROVENANCE.json. A retained copy of the CC BY 4.0 legal text
and the component-specific original attribution notice accompany them.
The source data contain 96 Crystal and 216 RPL archived trial summaries.

Changes in the present research

The own programs sort configurations and trial rows, compute exact means and
failure as one minus reliability, construct geometric certificate bounds and
paid-prefix transcripts, apply the documented row/point transformations and
select fixed subcatalogues using public hashes. Derived results are secondary
analysis of the cited data, not new physical measurements. Preserve attribution,
the licence link and the description of changes with downstream copies or
adaptations. No additional restriction is imposed on the upstream CC BY material.

Separate original software and article

The original APEX framework is a separately licensed software record under
DOI https://doi.org/10.3217/ckwaw-z8h92. Its source/firmware is not included or
executed by this companion. Its software licence is not used as a blanket grant
for the dataset or the new programs. The associated article is cited separately:
https://doi.org/10.1145/3770918. No article PDF or original article figure is included.

Author's new material

The final reuse licence for the new research code, newly generated outputs,
wrapper and documentation has not yet been selected or granted by Antonio Clim
in this workflow. No MIT, GPL, CC BY or other open licence is silently assigned.
The package is prepared for author review and for the subsequent approved
sharing/deposition route. Ask the author for the applicable rights before public
redistribution or reuse outside any independently applicable legal permission.
This pending decision does not alter rights already granted by the upstream
CC BY 4.0 licence. No public deposition or repository mutation is performed.

conclusion: Embedded author-created code and documentation explicitly have a pending licence decision. APEX upstream CC-BY-4.0 remains effective. No blanket licence was found or imposed. This review is static and does not grant new rights.
